result.topic_en: Notes on simultaneously approximating the integrals of a second-order linear differential equation (analogous to the Jacobi continued fraction algorithm) to draw conclusions about transcendence, on treating a free fluid jet with cylinder functions, and on Kronecker's attitude toward the logical foundations of mathematics.
